title.en: Expression rig with attention and gaze

summary: Give a character a small, well-chosen set of expression controls and let attention drive where those controls are aimed.
objective: Build a character head that notices a pointer, holds gaze with head and eye contribution and blends a few honest expressions.
intent_signals: Make a character that looks at my cursor and reacts.
Build a small expression system that does not look like a mask.
example_prompts: Build a character head with gaze tracking split between eyes and head plus a few blended expressions.
Create a mascot that notices the pointer, reacts and returns to a neutral pose.
negative_signals: Not a facial capture or retargeting pipeline.
Not an emotion recognition or affective computing claim; expressions here are authored poses.
not_for: Not a facial capture or retargeting pipeline.
Not an emotion recognition or affective computing claim; expressions here are authored poses.

entities.name: Expression set
entities.guidance: Author a small set of expressions with distinct shapes rather than many similar ones, and define which can blend together.

entities.name: Gaze split
entities.guidance: Divide gaze between eye rotation and head turn with declared limits, since eyes alone or head alone both look wrong.

entities.name: Attention model
entities.guidance: Hold an attention target with a dwell time and a return-to-neutral behaviour, so the character is not permanently locked on.

state_contract.model: Expression weights with declared exclusivity rules, a gaze target, an eye and head split with angle limits, blink timing and an attention state with dwell and release. Presentation follows the weights; the weights are the state.
state_contract.authority: Expression weights and the attention state are authoritative. A pose reached by animation but not represented in the weights cannot be queried, and that is a defect.
actions: Move the attention target and watch gaze follow.
Trigger an expression and blend it with another allowed one.
Release attention and let the character return to neutral.
Reset weights, gaze and blink timing.

invariants: Eye rotation stays inside its declared limit and the head takes over beyond it.

Exclusivity is enforced by a declared rule, not by per-weight bounds: expressions in a conflicting group have their weights normalised so the group sum stays at or below one, since individually bounded weights could otherwise both be fully active.
Blinking continues during gaze changes and expressions that do not intentionally close the eyes; an eye-closing expression suppresses independent blink motion.

When a gaze target exceeds the combined eye and head reach the head saturates at its limit and the residual is reported as unreachable, and a target at the eye origin is rejected rather than producing an undefined direction.
Expressions that intentionally close the eyes suppress the independent blink instead of fighting it.
motion_guidance: Lead the gaze with the eyes and follow with the head after a short delay, since simultaneous motion looks robotic.
Asymmetry in expression weights often reads as more alive, and is offered as a default worth trying rather than a rule; stylised characters can be deliberately symmetric.
known_limits: Authored expression set: no claim about universal emotion mapping or cultural reading of expressions.
Skin deformation quality depends on the rig and mesh supplied; this recipe specifies control, not geometry quality.
Authored guidance only: no scene runtime, rendering or numerical calibration has been run for this recipe.

object_craft.structure: Shape targets that change silhouette at brow, eyelid, mouth corner and cheek, not only surface texture.
object_craft.material: Skin material treatment is a style choice; subsurface warmth suits realistic characters while flat or stylised shading suits others. What matters is that shape changes stay readable, so avoid a finish that hides silhouette changes at the brow, eyelid and mouth corner.
object_craft.articulation: Weights blend additively within declared groups and exclusively across conflicting groups.

object_craft.structure: Eyes as real spheres in sockets with visible iris depth, and a neck chain that can turn and tilt.
object_craft.material: Eye materials with a clear specular highlight so gaze direction is readable from a distance.
object_craft.articulation: Eye rotation is clamped and the residual angle is passed to the neck chain.

physical_contract.scope: Authored pose blending and gaze aiming; no physical simulation of tissue or muscles.
checks: Eye rotation never exceeds the declared limit.

Releasing attention returns gaze and the attention-driven weights to neutral within the stated time; whether it also cancels independently triggered expressions is a declared coupling, stated in the scene.

creative_affordances: The character can be stylised or realistic; the split between eye and head contribution matters more than the rendering style.
Personality can be tuned by dwell time and return speed alone, without adding new expressions.
